newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease ahead of long weekend.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease ahead of long weekend.

text.p: Slovenian shares slipped 0.72 percent on reduced turnover on Wednesday ahead of the long holiday weekend but traders forecast a slightly firmer bias in the coming week.
The bourse will be closed on Thursday and Friday.
* The SBI index fell 8.69 points to 1,192.07.
* Turnover fell to 185.9 million tolars from 231.4 million.
* Bank SKB was most actively traded, firming 1.40 percent to an average of 40,273 tolars on volume of 1,803 shares. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
